identity.name: dANI.PT
identity.aesthetic: Swiss International Style x Automotive Brutalism
core_principles: Fusion: Automotive Sales + Swiss Poster Design
Content: High-fidelity car imagery is the hero
Contrast: Stark Black/White with Signal Red accents

rules: Headings (H1-H3) must use 'Archivo' in Black (900) or Bold (700) weight.

usage_rules: Primary Red (#E60000) is for CTAs and active states ONLY. Never use as a background for large sections.
Backgrounds must be pure White (#FFFFFF) or Light Grey (#F4F4F4).
Text must be high contrast Dark Grey (#1A1A1A), never pure black (#000000).
NO GRADIENTS. All colors must be flat and solid.

mode_b_density.description: For Car Listings / Admin. Dense and functional.
mode_b_density.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6

container_rules: Mobile-first: Always start with single column ('grid-cols-1').
Sections must have generous vertical padding ('py-20' or 'py-32').

variants.primary: bg-[#E60000] text-white hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] hover:text-white border-none shadow-none
variants.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#E5E5E5] text-[#1A1A1A] hover:border-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-transparent

cards.base_classes: bg-white border border-[#E5E5E5] rounded-[4px] overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 group

inputs.classes: rounded-[2px] border-[#E5E5E5] bg-[#F9F9F9] focus:border-[#1A1A1A] focus:ring-0 focus:bg-white transition-colors

badges.classes: rounded-[2px] font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-1

decorations: Massive typography (text-6xl to text-9xl) for background texture (opacity 5%).
NO drop shadows. Use borders for separation.

images.style_guide: Studio lighting, clean backgrounds, high contrast. Avoid cluttered street scenes.

hero_car.alt: White Hyundai Staria in minimalist showroom

happy_customer.alt: Group of people around white truck

rules: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Interactive elements must have visible focus states (ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-[#1A1A1A]).
All images must have descriptive alt text.
Use semantic HTML5 tags (main, section, article, nav, aside).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to 'index.css' immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update 'tailwind.config.js' with the custom colors and font families defined above.
3. CUSTOMIZE SHADCN: Modify 'button.jsx', 'card.jsx', and 'input.jsx' to remove default radii and shadows. Enforce the 'rounded-[2px]' rule.
4. BUILD LAYOUTS: Use the 'Tetris Grid' for the homepage. Do not create a generic 3-column layout.
5. ADMIN PANEL: Keep it dense (Mode B Grid). Use the 'swiss_border' card style for widgets.
6. DATA-TESTID: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
